channel.title: ~*Kara Suu Kyzy*~
channel.description: tüntolk, Mor-Wave, my friends and me ♥ Talas

item.description: I AM GETTING MARRIED ON SATURDAY!!!!! Nurlan's family came with the kuda on Sunday, the sep is ready, mama is crying every day, Talgat came from Almaty, Jyldyz is doing my nails. The toi is at the toikana on the river. 400 people. I am so nervous I can't eat. I will write after the wedding with…

item.title: 8 March ♥
item.description: Tulips from Nurlan. That is all I will say. ♥♥♥ OK one more thing: he likes Kök Bel and not tüntolk. Nobody is perfect.

item.title: Why Kara Suu is the best tüntolk album (essay)
item.description: My essay for our English class, the theme was "a work of art that is underrated". Grade: 5!! So I put it here. Everyone says Jolchu is the great one, and it is. But Kara Suu is braver. In 2004 everybody wanted tüntolk to make Jolchu again, and they made a dark album about the oily canals of…

item.title: Mor-Wave night
item.description: Mor-Wave night at Club Doran!! Two DJs from Almaty played old tüntolk, the Jolchu tracks, and the whole club sang "Kes, kes!" Mama thinks I was at Aika's doing homework. (Mama does not read my blog. I hope.) I have no voice now. Worth it.

item.title: stairwell kitchen
item.description: No light, no heat, but our building has GAS so all the neighbours cook together on the stairwell on two plates, it is almost a party. Auntie Raisa from floor 3 makes the best pelmeni. We play cards by candles. I am writing from the university computer centre (the warm one). See you in the light ★

item.title: Second year at TSU
item.description: Long time no write, sorry dear readers (all 4 of you). University is hard. Old Iradi literature is SO long. Our teacher reads Akyrky Ashuu to us like it is a thriller and actually... it is good?? Don't tell anyone. Talgat moved to Almaty to work. The house is quiet. Bars sleeps in his bed.

item.title: Askar at Talasfilm?!
item.description: Rumour (100% true, from Asel's sister who works in the canteen there): Askar Daniyarov from tüntolk works at Talasfilm now!!! In the sound department!!! Asel's sister saw him take kompot and a salad. He is VERY tall and says "rakhmat" very politely. I am a TSU student now (philology!!) so maybe…

item.title: still here ★
item.description: Still here. All of us. Jyldyz, Aika, Asel, Talgat, mama, papa, Bars. All alive. Our school has the windows broken, they say it will be repaired for September. They say the Synak will be later this year. I don't care. Everybody is alive. I listened to Jolchu all the time in the corridor on my…
we are ok. we sit in the corridor in the night, mama says away from the windows. school is closed. i write from the neighbours computer. i am scared. please pray for talas.

item.title: 2 years of Kara Suu
item.description: Today it is two years since Kara Suu came out. I listened to it all the way through in the dark, with headphones, like they say you should. Track 6 made me cry again. I don't know why. It is only a hum and a voice far away. Jyldyz says I am weird. I say I am deep. ★
